The '''''Cabur''-class starfighter''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] produced by [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]],<ref name="Forgotten" /> a renowned vehicle manufacturer based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="History">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> It was a wedge-shaped, twin-[[Engine/Legends|engine]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="Forgotten" /> flown by a pair of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="SW100" />

The ''Cabur''-class was manufactured following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Mandalore's last [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] advisor,<ref name="Forgotten" /> the [[Suprema]],<ref name="SW69">[[Star Wars (1977) 69|''Star Wars'' (1977) 69]]</ref> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="3ABY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars (1977) 69|''Star Wars'' (1977) 69]], which include the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Suprema]], to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> During the [[Nagai–Tof War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the extragalactic [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Forgotten" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] leader known by the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="History" /> [[Fenn Shysa]], led the twelve&ndash;''Cabur''-class&ndash;strong [[Resurrector Squadron]] of [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] in support of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], as the newly-formed government [[Second Battle of Endor|battled]] the [[Nagai expeditionary force|Nagai Fleet]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].<ref name="Forgotten" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|But in those scenes, and in the hangar in some earlier scenes, there are other various wedge-shaped ships. I figure that some of THOSE are Cabur-class.|[[James McFadden]]|<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31352511|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Guide to Warfare by Jason Fry and a pseudonymous Scotsman|user=[[James McFadden|JMM]]|date=2010-11-05|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220912234547/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-by-jason-fry-and-a-pseudonymous-scotsman.30937840/page-57}}</ref>}}
[[File:Cabur_candidates.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Potential examples of the ''Cabur''-class highlighted by James McFadden]]
The interior of the ''Cabur''-class [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was first depicted in the [[Star Wars (1977) 100|one-hundredth issue]] of [[Marvel Comics]]' [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'' series]] of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]],<ref name="SW100" /> written by [[Mary Jo Duffy|Jo Duffy]], illustrated by [[Cynthia Martin]], and published on [[October 1]], [[1985]],<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53886/star_wars_1977_100|text=Star Wars (1977) #100}}</ref> and it was identified by name in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] article ''[[The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs]]'' by [[James McFadden]].<ref name="Forgotten" /> Although McFadden did not establish a specific [[Starship/Legends|starship]] seen in the comic as the ''Cabur''-class, he suggested that it corresponded with one of several unidentified craft seen in the issue.<ref name="JCF" />

According to a dictionary of the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]] [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] written by [[Karen Traviss]] for [[Lucasfilm]], the word "Cabur" can be translated as "protector" or "guardian."<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref>
